say:2:1230120001:1.text: Yes. There are just too many people who need to have their boats fixed to set sail. Everyone is in a hurry, but it's still first come, first served.
say:2:1230120001:1.source_cn: 是的，想要修船出海的人实在太多。每个人都说急，可再怎么...

say:3:1230120002:1.text: I need to hurry up! The price of fish fluctuates every day, which means time is money!
say:3:1230120002:1.source_cn: 我是着急鱼的价格！现在鱼市的鱼价一天一变，时间就是金钱！

say:4:1230120003:1.text: Time is money? What were you doing before this?
say:4:1230120003:1.source_cn: 时间就是金钱？那之前你去干什么了？

say:5:1230120004:1.text: If you want my service, you need to follow my rules. Just stop complaining and get in line!
say:5:1230120004:1.source_cn: 想要我修船，就守规矩，给我闭嘴去后面排好！
